name: D3.js Visualizer
description: Data-driven charts, diagrams, and structured visual layouts using D3.js.
author: Generative Visual Engine Team

capabilities.name: scales
capabilities.description: Create linear, band, ordinal, and time scales for data mapping

capabilities.name: axes
capabilities.description: Render x and y axes with labels, ticks, and formatting

capabilities.name: layout
capabilities.description: Arrange visual elements using force, tree, pack, and partition layouts

capabilities.name: binding
capabilities.description: Bind data arrays to DOM elements using enter/update/exit pattern

capabilities.name: transition
capabilities.description: Animate elements with smooth transitions, easing, and delays
